sloka: गत्वा सौमित्रिसहितो नाविजित्य निवर्तते ।संग्रामात्पुनरागम्य कुङ्जरेण रथेन वा ॥२-२-३७॥
transliteration: gatvā saumitrisahito nāvijitya nivartate ।saṁgrāmātpunarāgamya kuṅjareṇa rathena vā ॥2-2-37॥

translations.english: While returning from the battlefield, either on a chariot or an elephant Rama stops and enquires in detail and in order, the welfare of the citizens as he would do for his kith and kin. He enquires about the welfare of their children, sacred rituals, wives, their servants and disciples as a father would enquire of his sons.
